interpretation: When the S5 nonlocal posterior is evaluated on the baseline controller's exact intervention sequence, it improves terminal edge error in all 12 S5 screen worlds and eliminates the three large harms. The harms arise from feeding the nonlocal posterior back into proposal/EIG policy selection, not from the terminal inference update itself. This supports a dual-posterior architecture: baseline posterior for experiment selection, nonlocal posterior for terminal structural inference.
